summary: FingerMotion, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a definitive Share Purchase Agreement dated September 23, 2026 to acquire 100% of Newbit Technology Inc., a British Columbia corporation registered in Alberta, from individual vendors for US$2,300,000 cash on a cash-free, debt-free basis, exclusive of GST. Newbit holds surface tenure, development and building permits, pipeline and metering infrastructure, environmental approvals and Alberta Utilities Commission Rule 007 registration tied to FingerMotion's disclosed 9.9 MW behind-the-meter site in Newell County, Alberta. A US$230,000 deposit was paid earlier, another US$230,000 is due on execution, with roughly US$1,840,000 payable at closing; no escrow or indemnity holdback applies. Closing targets the third business day after conditions are satisfied or waived, and by an outside date of October 29, 2026. Watch regulatory and permit-condition risk, the generating equipment carve-out requiring removal before closing, and the tight outside date.
